---
title: Storage egress protection
description: How private workspace downloads are bounded and protected against link sharing and replay.
updatedAt: '2026-10-31'
---

Private workspace files are downloaded through short-lived guarded links
rather than direct storage URLs.

- Existing Drive and Finance permission checks decide who can get a link.
- Links expire and can be revoked, and downloads are limited per file and
  overall, with daily and monthly transfer budgets per workspace.
- Responses are never cached, and storage credentials are never shown to
  callers.
- If the budget service is unavailable, downloads are denied rather than
  allowed unmetered.

Operational detail for these controls is maintained internally and is not published, because this repository is open source and published thresholds or rejection rules would help attackers.
